purpose: Evidence-first, AI-guided design support for peptide-programmed gold nanoclusters.

core_size.note: First promising retrospective signal; sample size remains small.

emission.note: Learned models do not beat the baseline.

plqy.note: Weak MAE reduction with negative out-of-fold R².

nuclearity.note: Near baseline under lab-aware stress testing, but not predictive.

formation.note: Negative controls are too sparse and concentrated in too few papers.

ptt.note: Insufficient direct peptide-templated AuNC sequence+synthesis→PTT training data.

validation_policy: Lab-grouped stress testing for known shared platforms
No predictive badge when learned models do not beat baseline
No production claim without external prospective validation
